props.label: About Us
props.heading: Straight answers on money matters
props.body:
Ashish Jain & Associates is a tax, finance and investment consultancy serving individuals, professionals and small businesses.

We handle the routine work properly — books kept current, returns filed on time, GST reconciled before it becomes a problem — so nothing turns into a notice you have to deal with later.

On insurance and mutual funds, we explain what a product actually does and what it costs before you commit to it. You deal with Ashish Jain directly, not a call centre, and the same person stays with your file year after year.

pillars.title: One point of contact
pillars.text: You deal with the same consultant every time, who already knows your file.

pillars.title: Deadlines tracked
pillars.text: We remind you before a filing is due, not after it has been missed.

pillars.title: Costs explained first
pillars.text: Charges and product costs are set out before any work or investment begins.

pillars.title: Records kept in order
pillars.text: Your documents and filings stay organised and available when you need them.

props.sub: Everything from day-to-day bookkeeping through to tax filing and investment planning, under one roof.

props.label: Who You'll Deal With
props.heading: Your consultant
props.sub: Add a photograph and your registration numbers here — clients look for them.

items.name: Ashish Jain
items.bio: Handles accounting, taxation and GST work, and advises on insurance and mutual fund investments. Reachable directly on phone or WhatsApp during office hours.

items.a: Call or send a WhatsApp message with a short note about what you need — a return filed, books to be set up, GST registration, or a look at your investments. We will tell you what documents to bring and roughly what it will cost before you come in.

items.q: What documents should I bring for tax filing?
items.a: Generally: PAN and Aadhaar, Form 16 or salary slips, bank statements for the year, interest certificates, and details of any investments or property. If you have filed with someone else before, bring last year's acknowledgement too. We will confirm the exact list for your case when you call.

items.q: Do you work with small businesses as well as individuals?
items.a: Yes. Individuals, professionals and small businesses — from a single annual return through to monthly bookkeeping and GST filing.

items.q: How are your charges worked out?
items.a: Charges depend on the scope of work and are agreed with you before anything begins. Ask when you call and we will give you a figure rather than a range.

items.q: Can things be handled without visiting the office?
items.a: For most routine work, yes — documents can be sent over WhatsApp or email and filings completed remotely. Some matters are simply quicker face to face, and we will say so if that is the case.

items.q: Do you advise on which insurance or mutual fund to choose?
items.a: We explain what each option does, what it costs and what its risks are, so the decision is an informed one. The final choice is always yours, and we will put the reasoning in writing if you want it.

props.heading: Happy with our work?
props.sub: A short review on Google genuinely helps other people find us — and tells us we are getting it right.

props.label: Office Timings
props.heading: When we're open
props.note: Closed on Sundays. Outside these hours, send a WhatsApp message and we will get back to you on the next working day.
